title: Army adapting NHI-derived electro-optic cloaking to combat vehicles

tellings.quote: There have been instances in the early 2000s in which specifically the army uh was interested in adapting electrooptic cloaking to next generation combat vehicle.

plain: In the early 2000s the Army was interested in fitting next generation combat vehicles with electro-optic cloaking, a way of making things hard to see, said to come from technology of non-human intelligence. A researcher who goes by the name UAPGerb tells Michels this as something he was told, and offers it as an example of how such technology might find its way into ordinary military equipment.
